context: A uni student interviews a retired traveler about regions visited
purpose: Teach: 神奈川/静岡/宮崎/埼玉/愛知/長崎/大分/熊本

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 今日はインタビューに応じてくださってありがとうございます。最初にお聞きしたいのですが、ご出身はどちらですか？
lines.en: Thank you for agreeing to this interview today. First, may I ask where you're originally from?
lines.style: Polite, slightly nervous student opening a formal interview with measured pacing.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 私は神奈川県の生まれでね、若い頃は隣の静岡県のお茶畑でアルバイトをしたこともあったよ。
lines.en: I was born in Kanagawa, and when I was young I even worked part-time in the tea fields of neighboring Shizuoka.
lines.style: Warm, nostalgic, slow elder cadence with gentle laughter between phrases.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: へえ、面白いですね。退職後はどのあたりを旅行されたんですか？
lines.en: Wow, that's fascinating. Which areas did you travel to after retirement?
lines.style: Curious, engaged student leaning forward, taking notes as he speaks.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: まずは九州を一周してね、宮崎県の海岸線、長崎の港町、大分の温泉、それから熊本城まで全部回ったよ。
lines.en: First I went around Kyushu — the Miyazaki coastline, the port towns of Nagasaki, the hot springs of Oita, and all the way to Kumamoto Castle.
lines.style: Proud, expansive recollection, listing destinations with rhythmic enthusiasm.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: すごい行動力ですね。関東や中部地方の方はどうでしたか？
lines.en: What an incredible level of activity. How about the Kanto and Chubu regions?
lines.style: Impressed, follow-up question delivered with respectful student tone.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 埼玉県の秩父にも行ったし、愛知県では昔の愛知万博の跡地も見学してきたよ。
lines.en: I went to Chichibu in Saitama, and in Aichi I even toured the former site of the Aichi Expo.
lines.style: Reflective, casual, sharing memories with mild pride and a soft chuckle.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本当に日本中を旅されたんですね。一番印象に残った場所はどこですか？
lines.en: You've truly traveled all over Japan. Which place left the strongest impression on you?
lines.style: Genuinely admiring, gently steering the conversation toward a personal reflection.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: やっぱり大分の温泉かな。湯けむりの中で、人生の重みがすうっと溶けていく気がしたんだ。
lines.en: It has to be the hot springs in Oita. Within the steam, I felt the weight of life quietly melting away.
lines.style: Thoughtful, poetic elder voice softening at the end with quiet emotion.
